texts.zh:
一个旅行团在[root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系登上了方舟舰，一边叽叽喳喳地聊着对旅途的期待一边踏入熙熙攘攘的舰船内舱。

我们订制了一条景色优美的路线，途经若干个值得一去的恒星系供他们游览。现在我们只需要交付好许诺给他们的美景就行了。
texts.en:
A group of tourists has boarded the Arkship in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system, chattering with anticipation as they take in the bustling interior of the vessel.

We have charted a scenic route through several remarkable systems for their enjoyment. Now we need only deliver the spectacle they were promised.

texts.zh: 游客欣赏着[root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的美景，惊叹于身边的种种奇景。当踏上归途时，他们将再也不同往日了，因为对宇宙之广阔的一手认知将会重塑他们。
texts.en: The tourists enjoyed the sights in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system, marveling at the wonders around them. They will return home changed, carrying with them first-hand knowledge of the vastness of the universe.

title.zh: 前往合约地点（观光旅行）
